zh.sourceText: 某公司宣布将全面取消远程办公。管理层解释，远程办公降低了团队协作效率，因为面对面沟通能减少误解；同时，线下办公更有利于新员工的快速成长。有员工担心这会增加通勤成本，但这种担心并不影响公司的决定。

textRefs.conclusion_1: 公司宣布将全面取消远程办公
textRefs.reason_1: 远程办公降低了团队协作效率
textRefs.reason_2: 线下办公更有利于新员工的快速成长
textRefs.distractor_1: 这种担心并不影响公司的决定

hints: 找一找公司想让你接受的立场——它宣布了什么？
理由由「因为」「同时」引出，它们回答『为什么这么做』
最后一句是在回应反对者，不是在为决定提供理由
zh.explanation: 「全面取消远程办公」是结论——公司希望你接受的立场。支撑它的理由有两个：「协作效率」与「新员工成长」，它们回答『为什么』。而最后那句回应员工担心的话，只是在反驳反对意见，并没有为决定提供任何新理由。理由 ≠ 反驳：区分「支撑结论的理由」和「回应质疑的辩驳」，是本章的核心能力。

en.sourceText: A company announces it will end remote work entirely. Management explains that remote work reduces team collaboration, because face-to-face communication prevents misunderstandings; meanwhile, working in the office helps new employees grow faster. Some employees worry this increases commuting costs, but such worries do not affect the company's decision.

textRefs.conclusion_1: it will end remote work entirely
textRefs.reason_2: working in the office helps new employees grow faster
textRefs.distractor_1: such worries do not affect the company's decision

hints: Find the position the company wants you to accept — what did it announce?
Reasons are introduced by 'because' and 'meanwhile' — they answer 'why'
The last sentence replies to opponents; it adds no support for the decision
en.explanation: “Ending remote work entirely” is the conclusion — the position the company wants you to accept. Two reasons support it: collaboration efficiency and new-employee growth; they answer “why”. The final sentence only rebuts employees' worries; it offers no new support for the decision. Reasons ≠ rebuttals: telling them apart is the core skill of this chapter.
